unsupported: Sinclair North America operates from New York, New York, as the U.S. arm of a global medical aesthetics company active in more than 55 countries.

The business focuses on the development and supply of injectable treatments, threads, and energy-based devices for aesthetic medicine, positioning itself at the intersection of science and clinical practice.

Beyond hardware, the company runs Sinclair College for professional education, maintains the Sinclair Portal for digital access, and provides electronic instructions for use (eIFU) to support clinical workflows.
These digital and educational services complement the physical product lines and aim to standardize treatment protocols across markets.
The company serves medical aesthetics practitioners, clinics, and healthcare providers worldwide.
This framework is intended to differentiate its approach in a competitive global landscape.
